summary: Özel et al. 2021 (Nature), the Drosophila optic lobe developmental atlas, rebuilt from GEO GSE142787 and the authors' own Seurat objects, replacing the old FlyBase/SCEA load FBlc0005659 with fresh VFBseq ids. Single-cell 10x data from female Canton-S optic lobes at five pupal stages (P15, P30, P40, P50, P70) and in 1-3-day adults: 38 Samples / Assays. Seven Clusterings (one per stage, plus the authors' P50 T4/T5 subtype split) with one Cluster per author final identity: 1,238 entries, 522 mapped to FBbt (immature terms up to the pupal stage, mature from the pharate adult stage) and loaded. Summary expression as CPM from the authors' raw counts (13,265 genes x 275,683 cells; 1,211,693 cluster x gene rows with extent > 0.2).

decisions.decision: Map to cell-level FBbt terms only (a tissue or organ author term maps to its cell-level equivalent, else the type is held).
Clusters with no FBbt term are held: listed in mapping.tsv with a hold_reason but not loaded (no VFBseq id, entity or expression rows). Their cells still count towards the Dataset's gene counts.
Summary expression is computed as CPM for every dataset.

Narrow a generic type by the dissected tissue only where the tissue makes the tissue-specific FBbt term exact (here: the optic-lobe-only dissection makes adult optic lobe glial cell exact for the numbered glia); hold clusters that could only be typed as 'cell' or 'neuron'; map known classes with a more specific broad term (glia).
Replace the old FlyBase/SCEA load FBlc0005659 (SCEA E-CURD-134, 66 merged clusters) with fresh VFBseq ids; its FBbt assignments are used only as a cross-check. Licence CC-BY-4.0.

One Clustering per stage (P15, P30, P40, P50, P70, adult), one Cluster per final identity present at that stage (the authors' adult cluster numbers, named in Supplementary Table 1); the per-stage unsupervised clusterings (an intermediate step) and the adult-male side analysis (issue #21) are not loaded.
Add the authors' P50-only split of the T4/T5 identities 234 (T4-5a/b) and 235 (T4-5c/d) into T4a-d / T5a-d as a seventh Clustering, each subtype a sub-cluster of 234 or 235.

Hold identities the authors left numbered (untyped; incl. letter-suffixed numbers such as 88a), low-quality LQ / G/LQ identities (artefact) and identity 0, the cells given no final identity (unassigned); map the less-confident names ('*') and flag them verification_needed.

Map numbered identities whose Supplementary Table 1 comment gives a probable type, unless the comment points to low quality: 93 'likely to be LC10c', 98 'Very likely to be a LC cell', 112 'best match for all kenyon cells' (config probable_identities; reviewed 2026-10-16).

Immature FBbt terms up to the pupal stage (P15, P30, P40), mature terms from the pharate adult stage (P50, P70, adult): two type-level mapping sets. Where FBbt has no immature form of a named type, the most specific ancestor with one is used (broad, new_term_needed); LPLC1 / LPLC2 at P15-P40 are held until immature terms exist.

Request the missing immature optic lobe types from FBbt (#2219: C2, C3, LC4, LC6, LC10a/b/c/d, LC12, LC16, LC17, LLPC1, LPC1, LPLC1, LPLC2, Lawf1, Lawf2, Tm5, Tm5a) and track the P15-P40 T2 / T2a / T3 clusters on #2216 (requested for Kurmangaliyev 2020); both in checks/pending_fbbt_requests.json.

Samples: adults 'mature adult stage', or day 1 / day 3 of adulthood where the authors give the age in the GSM title; Sample labels show the pupal tissue as 'optic lobe' (GEO's 'P70 optic lobe' repeats the stage), replicate ids as in GEO.

Samples from GEO: each GSM is one sample with one 10x library (paper: 15 adult, 5 each P15/P30/P70, 4 each P40/P50 libraries). Pupal Pxx (% of pupal development at 25 C, ~hours APF of the 100 h FBdv pupal period) to the Bainbridge & Bownes FBdv stage whose defined hours contain it: P15 pupal stage P5, P30 P6, P40 P7, P50 pharate adult stage P8, P70 P9. Tissue as for Kurmangaliyev 2020: embryonic/larval optic lobe to the pupal stage, adult optic lobe from the pharate adult stage. Sex from GEO (2 adult libraries pooled-sex, unset); no stock number given for Canton-S.

The authors' Seurat v3 objects are read with base R (no Seurat needed) and exported once per stage to .cache/ozel/<stage>/ (export_seurat.R: raw counts, symbol features, barcodes, cell metadata); clusters are built from the final identities (build_clusters.py), with each entry's Supplementary Table 1 comment kept as author_note.

Type mappings: 162 by script where no judgement is needed (confirm_terms.py: exact FBbt label / synonym and its immature form or nearest immature ancestor; TE neurons; numbered glia to adult optic lobe glial cell / glial cell), the rest by map-clusters-to-fbbt agents from reports, plus three by hand (Kenyon cell, LC neuron).

Expression from the raw UMI counts as CPM over each cell's own counts (adult main part, pupal extra parts; at P50 a T4/T5 cell is in its identity and its subtype); level the mean CPM over expressing cells, extent the fraction expressing, rows kept with extent > 0.2. Genes keyed by symbol: the FBgn other projects' source files give the symbol, else Chado by symbol (FB2026_03), an old symbol shared by several genes going to the one the literature overwhelmingly uses it for (>= 10 publications and >= 5x the next), else dropped.
All 522 mapped entries reviewed by the curator (mapping.tsv `reviewed`); held entries are not reviewed, as they are not loaded.

checks.check: verify_mappings.py: every FBbt term in the mappings looked up in OLS (FBbt 2026-10-01).
checks.result: 130 terms current, not obsolete, labels match.

checks.check: FBbt, FBdv and FBcv terms on the Samples, Assays and Dataset looked up in OLS.
Mapping definitions compared with the FBbt 2026-10-01 release text.
checks.result: All verbatim (agent paraphrases corrected before commit).

checks.check: Cross-check against Kurmangaliyev 2020 (main dataset) mappings for the same author types.
checks.result: 53 of 55 shared types alike; the other two are Dm3a / Dm3b, exact here (FBbt defines them from this paper) and Dm3 in Kurmangaliyev (equivalence not established).

checks.check: Cross-check against the old load FBlc0005659 (metadata release file), by type name.
checks.result: All 49 types matched by name agree; the old load also names LC10c, LC9, Dm15, Mt8 and LPi3-4, which Supplementary Table 1 leaves numbered or does not use.

checks.check: Marker spot checks in the expression output.
checks.result: Tm9d Wnt10 (0.84) and Tm9v Wnt4 (0.40), each without the other (as FBbt defines Tm9a / Tm9b); identity 112 ey / Pka-C1 / prt (Kenyon cells); NB dpn / ase / mira; LPC gcm / eya; PR ninaE; Mi1 hth; L1 svp; G01 repo. Dm3b's bi is below the cut-off in adults.

checks.check: Export and cluster sizes: adult cells against the paper; identities against Supplementary Table 1.
checks.result: 109,743 adult cells, as in the paper; every final identity except 0 is in the table.

ontologies.label: Drosophila developmental ontology
ontologies.accessed_via: OLS4 API; local fbdv.obo in .cache (stage definitions)

data_sources.label: Neuronal diversity and convergence in a visual system developmental atlas
data_sources.description: Özel et al. 2021, Nature. Full text indexed locally for the report subagents; Supplementary Table 1 (cluster numbers, names and annotation comments) is the source of the cluster names.

files.description: JATS full text (author manuscript), NCBI efetch (db=pmc).
Supplementary Table 1 (cluster annotation: number, name, adult and pupal comments), Nature ESM.

data_sources.label: Neuronal diversity and convergence in a visual system developmental atlas (scRNA-seq)
data_sources.description: GEO series: 38 single-cell 10x libraries from optic lobes (15 adult, 23 pupal). Sample metadata read live (SOFT); the authors' per-stage Seurat objects are its supplementary files (checksums of the .rds files as downloaded and decompressed).

data_sources.label: Kurmangaliyev 2020 (this repo)
data_sources.description: Mapping cross-check for shared optic lobe types; its gene id map (with Davie 2018, FCA 10x and AFCA) supplies FBgn ids for symbols (gene_ids_from).

data_sources.label: scRNAseq_2021_Ozel
data_sources.description: The old FlyBase/SCEA load this project replaces (SCEA E-CURD-134); its metadata release file (vfb-scRNAseq-ontology at 1120a60) was used only as a mapping cross-check.

software.label: Claude Code
software.description: Agentic CLI that ran the session (orchestrator) and its subagents, stages 1-5.

software.label: R
software.description: Reads the authors' Seurat objects (base R, Homebrew; Seurat not installed) for export_seurat.R.

software.label: Atlas Reporter (local-paper-index)
software.description: Local JATS snippet index of the paper, queried by the report subagents.

software.label: OLS4 (Ontology Lookup Service)
software.description: FBbt / FBdv / FBcv lookup during mapping (OLS MCP) and term verification.

software.label: FlyBase Chado
software.description: Gene symbols mapped to current FlyBase genes (update_gene_ids.py), incl. synonym publication counts for ambiguous old symbols.

software.label: NCBI GEO
software.description: Series and Sample SOFT metadata read by ingest.fetch_series (build_samples_from_geo.py).

software.label: ROBOT
software.description: OFN to OWL/XML conversion (metadata and expression OWL).

models.label: Claude Opus 5.5
models.description: Main Claude Code session: scoping, R export, sample and cluster builds, the stage-specific mapping scheme and confirm script, checks and corrections of agent output (Tm9d / Tm9v, definitions), probable identities, expression and builds.

models.label: Claude Sonnet (agent default)
models.description: write-cell-type-report subagents (31 type reports) and map-clusters-to-fbbt subagents (36 type mappings), per the agent frontmatter (model: sonnet).
